snippet.title: POWA! for GB(C) Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The new GB platformer POWA! is finally available as a physical cartridge and digital ROM release!

Physical: https://firstpressgames.com/collections/powa/
Digital: https://aiguanachein.itch.io/powa

The gameplay of POWA!  is decidedly kept tight and simple and makes it easy to pick it up, but challenging to conquer! A good variety of level themes and obstacles, with an ever-increasing difficulty curve creates a thoroughly versatile and engaging platforming-experience.

Features:
・ a brand-new GBC game with backwards-compatibility to Classic GB hardware
・ clean and simple platformer-gameplay with tight controls
・ five levels with multiple segments and challenging boss fights
・ super-cute presentation and a bopping soundtrack
・ replay-value through varying difficulty modes and a timescore after each play-through
・ utilizes Super Game Boy-features when played on a SNES/SFC


Trailer concept & cut by Dengeki Gamer
